Commentary.Commentary: Right then. With England sweeping the series 3-0, they will march ahead now to the ODI series and will battle the Sri Lankans out. The first ODI will take place at the Riverside Ground, Chester-le-Street on 29th June at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Do join us for that. Till then, take care and cheers!

Eoin Morgan is up for a chat- He says that he has been most impressed with the bowling department. Adds that the guys adapted to the conditions really well. Mentions that to bowl 16 overs on the trot is amazing and cannot fault the bowlers for anything. He adds that he is looking forward to the T20 world cup and is proud of the guy's batting. States that the partnership between Malan and Bairstow was top-notch.

Kusal Perera is up for a chat- He says that to find the tempo is going to be tough and the batting has not been up to the mark. Adds that the batters are not used to the pace and bounce and there is an issue there. Mentions that the batters need to take responsibility and step up their game.
Sam Curran, MAN OF THE MATCH, is here for a chat- He says that he is pleased with how the series went. Adds that he tries to do his best in whatever role is given to him.

David Malan, PLAYER OF THE MATCH is up for a chat says- He says that it is always nice to score runs. Scoring runs at the winning end is always a nice feeling. Adds that the partnership towards the end was crucial and credits himself and Bairstow for managing to post the total above 180. He mentions that he prefers the opening slot. Further states that the way Morgan backs them to play is brilliant. Goes onto say that he would like to play all three formats for England.

No matter how many changes the English side makes to their bowling line-up they never seem to shake off. David Willey strikes in his first over and went on to pick up three wickets on the day. The four pacers did their job really well, as they picked up 8 wickets in total. After completing their spell, the spinners were called upon. Liam Livingstone knocked out Binura Fernando in the end. Later, Ali bowled the penultimate over and got the final man to bundle Sri Lanka out for 91.

The Sri Lankan top-order continued to disappoint as they lost three wickets before the powerplay. Then, it was Oshada Fernando to depart, he never looked settled in the middle as he only wanted to play the shots on the leg side and failed miserably. Fernando and Dickwella were in the middle for long, but were struggling to add runs on the board. After the former was departed, Sri Lanka witnessed a batting collapse as they lost their next four wickets in quick succession and found themselves at 64 for 8. Later the tail-enders got rattled out to the spinners.
Well then it was all about England yet again. As they restricted Sri Lanka to a low score of 91 and the hosts win the series comfortably by 3 to nothing.

OUT! LBW! THAT'S THE GAME! Tossed up on middle,  Dushmantha Chameera looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and England straightaway appeals for an LBW. The umpire raises his finger. Sri Lanka reviews it. Ultra Edge confirms no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows umpire's call on wickets hitting. ENGLAND WIN BY 89 RUNS.
Review taken for LBW. Onfield decision is OUT. Ultra Edge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracker shows the wickets hitting on umpire's call. And the decision stands.
Flatter ball on off, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short outside off, clipped to mid-wicket.
Floated it up on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle, flicked towards square leg for a single.
On off, Chameera is solid in his defense.
Outside off, left alone.
Dushmantha Chameera is the last man to walk in.

OUT! BOWLED! Liam Livingstone has the last laugh! Bowls a flatter delivery on middle and leg, hurries through the batsman, Binura Fernando goes off the back foot to slog sweep but misses it altogether. The ball shatters the woodwork. England one wicket away.
SIX! BANG! Loopy ball, on off, Fernando skips down the track and powers it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Floated, on the pads, Lakshan Sandakan flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, on the pads, Fernando works it to point for a single.
Liam Livingstone comes into the attack now.
Loopy ball on off, Fernando slams it down the ground to long off for a run.
Short again on middle, worked past point for a brace.
FOUR! A rare boundary! Short ball, Binura Fernando pulls it away to deep square leg for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Fernando heaves it towards long off for a couple.
Quicker on leg, Fernando misses his attempted flick.
Starts with a googly on leg, defended watchfully.
Adil Rashid comes into the attack now.
Fuller length on middle, blocked out.
Serves a full ball on off, driven towards covers.
Length ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Length delivery on off, tapped towards point.
Good length delivery outside off, Sandakan miss his cut shot. The ball goes through to the keeper.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Sandakan misses his flick. Wided.
Length delivery on off, Fernando drives the ball through covers. He will get three.
Fuller ball on off, Sandakan pushes it back to the bowler.
Length ball, nipping back in, Sandankan looks to defend but the ball goes through the gate.
Fuller on off, pushed towards mid on for a single.
TWO LEG BYES! Length delivery on leg, Fernando gets hit on the pads. The ball goes past the keeper. Ali dives in and saves two for the team.
The next batsman to walk in at No. 10 is Lakshan Sandakan.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sri Lanka are eight down! Three wickets for David Willey! Back of a length delivery on middle, Isuru Udana pulls it but didn't get the elevation. The ball goes off the top edge straight into the bucket hands of Moeen Ali at fine leg. England two wickets away from getting a victory.
Commentary.Howout: c Moeen Ali b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller on off, Udana pushes it to mid off.
Length delivery on off, Binura goes for the drive but misses on the outer edge.
Outside off, Fernando gets beaten.
Binura Fernando is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sri Lanka falling like a pack of cards now! Good length delivery on off, Wanindu Hasaranga has a poke at it. The ball finds the outside edge and goes to Dawid Malan at first slip who takes it easily. Test natch kind of wicket. You don't see such wickets in T20's too often. Wanindu Hasaranga departs. Chris Jordan enters the wicket column as well.
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length delivery on off, tapped towards point.
Beaten! Good length delivery on off, Hasaranga goes for the drive but misses.
Back of a length outside off, Hasaranga is beaten as he pokes at it.
Good length ball, on off, Udana defends it to cover. Just two and a wicket off the over.
On off, kept out.
Isuru Udana is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sri Lanka is falling apart at the moment. Sam Curran gets his second wicket. A full length ball, on off, Niroshan Dickwella chips it towards mid on, off the inner half of the blade. He started walking away as soon as he hit the ball. Chris Jordan takes a comfortable catch at mid on.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: A touch short on off, Hasaranga defends it to the off side and scamper through for a single.
A length ball, on the pads, Dickwell flicks it uppishly towards mid-wicket. The ball falls in a no mans land. A single taken.
BEATEN! On a length, outside off, Dickwella looks to go big but misses,
A length ball, on off, Hasaranga cuts it to point.
Good length ball, outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga leaves it alone.
Outside off, left alone.
BYE! A length ball, outside leg, Dickwella follows the line of the delivery and looks to push it away but misses. The batters sneak a single. Bye. Singles aren't going to bother England.
Wanindu Hasaranga walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another one goes down for Sri Lanka, more problems for them. A full length ball, on off, Shanaka flicks it through mid-wicket and takes off for a single. Shanka wanted the second run as well, but Billings was quick in the field. As he collects it and hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. Shanaka ventured out, looking for a run, only to be sent back by Niroshan Dickwella. He puts in a dive but is too late for that. Half the side back in the hut now.
BEATEN! Peach of a delivery. A length ball, on off, Shanaka looks to defend but misses.
Good length ball, on off, Shanaka pulls it to long on for a single.
NO BALL! A bouncer on middle, Shanaka looks to pull this one but misses. The umpire gives a no ball because of too many short balls. A free hit to follow.
FOUR! A good length ball, down the leg side, Shanka pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary. Just the third boundary of the Sri Lankan innings so far.
A short ball, outside off, Shanaka looks to hook it but only manages to get the toe end of the bat, the ball rolls to first slip.
Back of a length ball, on middle, Shanaka looks to pull it but misses. The ball bounces over his blade.
Full and outside off, Shanaka pushes it to point.
A length ball, on off, Dickwella flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, kept out by Shanaka. 128 required in the last 10 overs. A tough task for Sri Lanka.
BEATEN! Peach of a delivery on off, Shanaka looks to defend but misses. A whisker away getting the outside edge.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Shanaka misses his flick. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Short outside off, Shanaka has a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball on middle, Dickwella moves across ad lofts it over the bowler's head. A single taken. He is not able to find his rhythm.
Fuller length on off, Shanaka pushes it towards point.
Length delivery on off, Niroshan Dickwella goes for the paddle scoop but took his eyes off early. The ball gets hit on his shoulders and rolls on the off side. A leg bye taken.
Chris Woakes comes into the action now.
Fuller length outside off, Shanaka drills it to backward point.
Length ball on off, nipping in, Shanaka looks to defend but gets struck on the thigh pad.
Short and wide outside off, Dickwella goes for the pull. The ball goes off the toe-end of the bat towards third man for a a single.
Back of a length delivery on leg, Shanaka misses his flick. The ball goes off the hips and he runs a leg bye.
Length delivery on off, pushed towards covers for one.
Dasun Shanaka walks in at No.6.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sam Curran strikes! Sri Laka in tatters now! Back of a length delivery on off, Oshada Fernando tries to lift it but miscues his shot. The ball goes straight to David Willey at point who takes the simplest of catches. An iffy knock comes to end. Sri Lanka in deep trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c David Willey b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: God length delivery on off, nipping away, Dickwella aims for a big shot but doesn't connect it. Bairstow does well to grab the swinging ball diving to his left.
Back of a length delivery on off, Niroshan Dickwella is early into his pull. The ball beats the bat and goes into the keeper's gloves.
Slower and short on off, Dickwella is late into his shot.
WIDE! Outside off and outside the tramline. Wided.
Back of a length delivery on off, Fernando taps it on the leg side. That came off the gloves.
On a length on leg, Dickwella guides it on the leg side for a quick single.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball outside off, Niroshan Dickwella goes for the cut shot but misses.
Length delivery outside off, Fernando swishes and misses.
Pitches it full on off, Fernando jams it down onto the pitch.
WIDE! Short ball outside off, Fernando goes for a massive hoick but misses. Wided.

In the air.....but safe! Length delivery on leg, Niroshan Dickwella hits it uppishly over extra covers. Liam Livingstone who took a stunner earlier, runs from the deep to grab this one. Gets hands to it but just not enough. A single taken.
BEATEN! An outswinger, outside off, Dickwella leans into his drive but misses.
Back of a length delivery on off, punched towards point for one.
Length delivery on the pads, Dickwella misses his flick. The ball hits his front pad and rolls on the off side. The batters take a run off leg bye. Half-hearted appeal for an LBW but turned down.
Sam Curran comes into the attack now.
A length ball, on the body line. Fernando defends it to the leg side.
BEATEN! A good length all, on off, Fernando swings his blade in hope but cannot find any connection. The ball goes over the stumps into the keepers mitts.
Play and a miss! A length ball, outside off, Oshada Fernando looks to pull it but misses.
SIX! BANG! Full length ball, on off, Fernando powers it over the bowlers head for a maximum.
BEATEN! A length ball, outside off, Fernando looks to defend but misses.
Good length ball, outside off, Fernando extends his arm, as the ball goes onto the pitch off the bottom edge.
FOUR! A positive end to the over for Sri Lanka. On the pads, Dickwella works it towards fine leg fence for a boundary.
On off, kept out.
Niroshan Dickwella is the new batsman in.

Sri Lanka has taken a review for caught behind. Kusal Mendis thinks he has not edged it. Ultra Edge shows a clear spike as the ball passes the bat. The on-field decision stays. Sri Lanka lose their review.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! This is all going downhill for Sri Lanka, this has been their tale in this series. The top order collapses in no time for them here. Third one is down now. A good lenght ball, outside off, Mendis looks to push it out. But he only manages to find an outside edge as the keeper takes an easy catch behing the wickets. There is a huge appeal for Caught behind, umpire waits and raises his finger. Kusal Mendis looks confused as he takes the review. The Ultra Edge confirms there was spike as the ball passes the bat. The decision stands.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! That's how it's done! Length delivery outside off, Kusal Mendis opens the face of the bat, sails it over long on for a maximum.
Good length delivery outside off, Mendis looks to defend but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge, into the keeper's mitts.
A length ball, on off, Mendis works it to mid on.
Kusal Mendis walks out to bat at No.4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Woakes gets into the action now. This is great work by Liam Livingstone to catch the ball. Full length ball, on leg. Perera clips it towards mid-wicket, he was a little early into the shot. The ball stays in the air for quite sometime. As Liam Livingstone does an amazing job coming in and takes a sharp low catch to dismiss the Lankan skipper.
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Livingstone b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, on off, Fernando looks to pull it but only gets an inside edge as the ball rolls towards fine leg for a single.
A length ball, on off, Fernando looks to scoop it but misses.
A length ball, around middle, nips in. Perera guides it to point and takes off. Ali collect the ball and has a shy at the striker's end. The replays show the batsman is well inside the crease.
Good length ball, outside leg stump. Perera moves away and looks to heave this one. But misses as the ball goes through to the keeper. Jonny Bairstow dives to his right to make an excellent stop.
Good length ball, on the pads, Oshada Fernando tucks it to short fine leg for a single.
Two More! A length ball, on off, Perera lifts it over cover for a couple.
A length ball, on off, Fernando pushes it to cover for a single.
A length ball, on middle, Oshada Fernando flicks it through sqaure leg for a couple.
On off, kept out.
A length ball, on off, Perera again looks to flick it but misses, the ball clips the pads and rolls to point. A single taken. Leg bye.

Good length ball, on off, Perera looks to flick it but gets an outside edge instead. The ball goes towards the second slip but falls short. There is a bit of a confusion as Oshada Fernando comes down the track looking for a run. He is sent back by Kusal Perera. The fielder thows the ball at the non strikers end but misses.
Length delivery on off, Oshada Fernando paddle scoops it. The ball goes off the top edge to third man. Two taken. Excellent start for Chris Woakes.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length delivery outside off, nipping away, Fernando misses his shot and is beaten.
Width on offer outside off, Fernando reaches out for the shot but misses. He wants to go big but is not able to connect. 4 dots now.
Back of a length delivery outside off, nipping away, Fernando again goes for the big shot but connects it with thin air.
Clever! Bowls a slower one now, on off, Fernando is beaten by the pace there as he looks to pull.
BEATEN! Length delivery outside off, swinging away, Fernando went hard for the pull but is comprehensively beaten.
Chris Woakes to bowl from the other end.
LEG BYE! Once again Fernando looks to paddle scoop but misses and get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg. The batters sneak a single.
A length ball, on off, kept out.

A full length ball, on off, Fernando gets low and looks to paddle sweep it. The ball takes the top edge and flies towards the short fine leg fielder. The man puts in a dive in front of him but the ball lands safely. Couple taken.
THREE WIDES! Down the leg side, swinging away. Fernando looks to flick it but misses. The keeper does get a hand to it but it wasn't enough as the batters take two.
Full and outside off, Fernando lofts it over cover for a couple.
Oshada Fernando walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! David Willey strikes in his first over. Not what the Islanders envisioned. This is poor. He cover drives the first ball and gets beaten in the next. Serves a length ball, on off, the ball gets an extra bounce after hitting the deck, which surprises Danushka Gunathilaka. He looks to loft it over the slip cordon. But gets an outside edge and the ball flies to the second slip, where Dawid Malan clings onto the ball.
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! What a start to this chase. That is an amazing shot. A full length ball, outside off, Danushka Gunathilaka leans and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
